items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: Wash all face once.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: Wash both hands including elbows once.

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat:
Massage a quarter of the head once. 4. Wash both feet including the ankles once. (the)

Benefits: Ablution will not be valid if one of the above four tasks is not performed or even one hair is dry.
items.reference: Evidence: Shami, 1:91 / Al Bahrur Rayiq, 1:9 / Hidayah, 1:16

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat: Making the intention of ablution means that the person performing ablution should make the intention in his heart that he is performing ablution in order to attain purity and for the prayer to be permissible.
items.reference: Surah Bayynah, 5/ Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No-6689

items.title: Sunnah 5
items.fazilat: Begin ablution by reciting Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. It is said in the hadith that if one performs ablution after reciting Bismillah wal Hamdulillah, as long as that ablution lasts, the angels will continue to write rewards in his name, even if he is engaged in any mubah.
items.reference: Nasa'i Sharif, Hadith No. 78 / Tabrani Sagir, 1: 73

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat: Wash both hands separately including wrists three times.

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat: to miswalk If there is no Miswak, it is mustahabb that the Miswak for brushing the teeth with the fingers should not be longer than half a hand and be a branch of a tree.
items.reference: Musnad Ahmad, Hadith No-9216, 139, 3990 / Tirmidhi, Hadith No-23 / Baihaqi, Hadith No-174

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat: Three times porter.

items.title: Sunnah 9
items.fazilat: Watering the nose three times and clearing the nose.

items.title: Sunnah 10
items.fazilat: At the same time, wash the nose every time.

items.title: Sunnah 11
items.fazilat: Wash each organ thoroughly three times. For this, water should be taken more than three times.

items.title: Sunnah 12
items.fazilat: Washing the face with both hands and brushing the beard while washing the face.

items.title: Sunnah 13
items.fazilat: Cross fingers while washing hands and feet.

items.title: Sunnah 14
items.fazilat: Massage the entire head once.

items.title: Sunnah 15
items.fazilat: Massage both ears. Remember to massage by inserting the little finger into the ear hole and with the shahadat finger on the remaining part.
items.reference: Tirmidhi, Hadith No-33 / Abu Dawud, Hadith No-135

items.title: Sunnah 16
items.fazilat: Wash the parts of ablution by hand.
items.reference: Mustadarak, Hadith No-576 / Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah, Hadith No-118

items.title: Sunnah 17
items.fazilat: Do not delay washing one part after washing another part.
items.reference: Muslim, Hadith No-243 / Abu Dawud, Hadith No-173

items.title: Sunnah 18
items.fazilat: Perform ablution with taratib. That is to maintain continuity while washing the organs of Wudu.

items.title: Sunnah 19
items.fazilat: Wash the right side limb first.

items.title: Sunnah 20
items.fazilat: When you do not want to perform ablution due to cold or any other reason, you should still perform ablution by washing the parts of the ablution properly.
items.reference: Tirmidhi, Hadith No-51 / Muslim, Hadith No-251

items.title: Sunnah 21
items.fazilat:
Recite the following two verses during ablution:

اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ ذَنبِـيْ وَوَسِّعْ لِـيْ فِيْ دَارِيْ وَبَارِكْ لِيْ فِيْ رِزْقِيْ.

(Amalulawami wal Lailah li Ibnissunni, hadith no-28)

And reciting Shahadat in Kalima after ablution. (Muslim Sharif, Hadith No-234)

Then recite this Dua: (Tirmidhi, Hadith No. 55)

اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَوَّابِيْنَ, وَاجْعَلْنِـيْ مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ

It should be noted that at the beginning and end of ghusl and tayammum, the dua mentioned in ablution will be recited.

B. Dr. It is not possible to perform ablution in the Sunnah way just by reading all these narrations, for this a Haqqani scholar will take a visual look at all the issues. Allah Ta'ala taught the Prophet sallallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam by showing all things visually through Hazrat Gabriel.

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ ذَنبِـيْ وَوَسِّعْ لِـيْ فِيْ دَارِيْ وَبَارِكْ لِيْ فِيْ رِزْقِيْ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَوَّابِيْنَ، وَاجْعَلْنِـيْ مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ

items.title: Sunnah 8

items.fazilat:
Water the entire body three times in such a way that not even a hair root is dry. (Abu Dawud, Hadith No-49 / Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaiba, Hadith No-813)

However, if you take a bath in a river, pond, etc., the sunnah of pouring water three times will be fulfilled if you dip for a while.

categories.title: Sunnah of sleeping and waking up

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat:
Try to sleep as early as possible after the Isha prayer, so that it is easier to get up for Tahajjud. (Bukhari, Hadith No. 547)

B. Dr. It is mentioned in the hadith that the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to sleep on the ground, a post, a cloth bed, a mat, a leather bed, etc.
items.reference: Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No. 2069/Shamayil Tirmidhi, p. 22

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: Bed with ablution.

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat: Shake the bed well before going to bed.

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat: Change into sleeping clothes before going to bed.

items.title: Sunnah 5
items.fazilat: Saying 'Bismillah' before going to bed and doing the following: 1. close the door 2. Covering water containers and food containers and other containers. If no object is available for covering, then placing a stick or stick in his mouth saying 'Bismillah', 3. Turn off the lights.

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat: Surma is applied three times on both eyes before sleeping.

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat: Reciting some amount of Quran Sharif before going to bed. Namely: Recitation of Alhamdu Sharif, Surah Kafirun, Ayatul Kursi, Amana Rasool to the end of Surah Baqara, Surah Mulk, Alif Lam Meem Sijdah etc. If it is not possible to read more then read at least 2/3 small Surahs.
items.reference: Tabrani Kabir Hadith No-2195 / Al Adabul Mufrad, Hadith No-1209 / Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No-3275

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat: Reciting Durood Sharif a few times before going to sleep and reciting Tasbeeh Fatemi i.e. 33 times Subahanallah, 33 times Alhamdulillah and 34 times Allahu Akbar.

items.title: Sunnah 9
items.fazilat: Reciting Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq and Surah Nas three times each and wiping the entire body from head to toe as much as possible. Do this three times.

items.title: Sunnah 10
items.fazilat: Shua Sunnah while sleeping with the right ear facing the Qibla. Prone sleeping is prohibited. Because Allah does not like sleeping like this.
items.reference: Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No. 6314 / Sahih Ibn Hibban Hadith No. 5549

items.title: Sunnah 11
items.fazilat:
Reciting this dua while sleeping:

بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّـىْ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِيْ وَبِكَ اَرْفَعُهٗ اِنْ اَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْلَهَا وَاِنْ اَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِه عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ.

amal_text.text: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّـىْ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِيْ وَبِكَ اَرْفَعُهٗ اِنْ اَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْلَهَا وَاِنْ اَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِه عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ.

items.title: Sunnah 12
items.fazilat:
Read this Istighfar three times before sleeping:

اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَاۤ  اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ

amal_text.text: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَاۤ  اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ

items.title: Sunnah 13
items.fazilat: Also recite this dua: اَللّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ اَمُوْتُ وَاَحْيَا

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ اَمُوْتُ وَاَحْيَا

items.title: Sunnah 14
items.fazilat:
Finally read these two:

اَللّٰهُمَّ اَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ اَمْرِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَاَلْجَاْ تُ ظَهْرِيْ اِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً اِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَاَ وَلَا مَنْجَاَ مِنْكَ اِلَّا اِلَيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اٰمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِيْ اَ نْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِيْ اَرْسَلْتَ.

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ اَمْرِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَاَلْجَاْ تُ ظَهْرِيْ اِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً اِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَاَ وَلَا مَنْجَاَ مِنْكَ اِلَّا اِلَيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اٰمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِيْ اَ نْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِيْ اَرْسَلْتَ.

items.title: Sunnah 15
items.fazilat:
After going to bed, if you do not sleep because of fear, read this dua:

بِسْمِ ا للّٰهِ اَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهٖ وَعِقَابِهٖ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهٖ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَاَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنَ.

amal_text.text: بِسْمِ ا للّٰهِ اَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهٖ وَعِقَابِهٖ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهٖ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَاَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنَ.

Lie down and spit on the left side and sleep. There is no further risk of harm and these two readings:

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هٰذِهِ الرُّؤْيَا

items.fazilat: If there is a chance, do Qailullah for a while after eating at noon, that is, go to bed. Want to sleep or not.

amal_text.text: اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا اَمَاتَنَا وَ اِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ.

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, preferred white clothes.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: Right hand and right foot should be inserted first while wearing all kinds of clothes including clothes and pajamas.

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat: Pajama, lungi and dress for men, jubba and aba-kaba above the ankles. It is haram to wear clothes below the ankles. Huzoor sallallaahu 'alaihi wa sallam said - 'Whoever wears a garment hanging below his ankle, Allah Ta'ala will not look at him with mercy on the Day of Resurrection. B. Dr. Exceptions to the socks rule.

items.reference: Amalul Yawmi Wal Laylah, Hadith No-274 / Musannafe Ibn Abi Shaybah, Hadith No-24910

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat: Shoes are first worn on the right foot, then on the left foot.

items.title: Sunnah 9

categories.title: The Sunnahs of the call to prayer

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: Giving the call to prayer in a pure state.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: Calling the adhan facing the Qiblah and keeping a space of four fingers between both feet facing the Qiblah.
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Hadith No-507 / Musannaf Abdur Razzaq, Hadith No-1802

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat:
A. Stop saying the first two takbeers together in one breath.

b. Then the two takbeers are said together in one breath and stop.

B. Dr. At the end of each of the mentioned takbirs is to make Sakin, i.e. not to say 'Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar' like this. (Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah, Hadith No-2377)

c. Then speaking one sentence at a time from the middle sentences, and at the end of each sentence, rest and pause. (Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah, Hadith No-2377)

d. Stop saying the last two takbeers together in one breath and make Sakin at the end of both takbeers.

e. Finally, end the call to prayer by saying La-Ila-Ha-Illallah. (Nasa'i, Hadith No. 652)

It should be noted that, after stopping to say one sentence, to pause so much that the read sentence can be read once; That is, the listeners should be able to respond to the adhan at that time.
items.reference: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah, hadith no-2234

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat: Saying 'Hayya Alassalah' after turning the face to the right and saying 'Hayya Alal Falah' after turning the face to the left. But the chest and legs will not turn from the direction of Qibla.

items.title: Sunnah 5
items.fazilat: As soon as the first adhan of the mahalla is heard, the recitation, dhikr, tasbeeh, etc. of the listeners are stopped until the end of the adhan.

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat: Answering the call to prayer. That is to say the exact words of the adhan of the listeners in between the muezzin's pronunciation of the adhan. But after saying 'Hayya Alassalah' and 'Hayya Alal Falah' the answer is to say 'La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah'. And saying 'Sadaqta wa Bararata' in response to 'Assalatu Khairum Minan Naum' in Fajr Azan.
items.reference: Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No-611,613 / Muslim Hadith No-385

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat: Recitation of Durood Sharif at the end of Azaan.

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat:
Then read this dua:

اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّاْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ اٰتِ مُحَمَّدَانِ الْوَسِيْلَةَ وَالْفَضِيْلَةَ وَابْعَثهُ مَقَامً مَّحْمُوْدَانِ الَّذِيْ وَعَدْتَّهٗ. اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ.

(Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No-614, 4719 / Baihaqi Hadith No-1933)

B. Dr. It is not sahih to make the takbeers of the adhan more than one alif, especially the second takbeer, and it is gravely wrong to create waves in the sound, i.e., to raise and lower the sound at will.
items.reference: Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No-609/ Darakutani, Hadith No-906/ Ad Durrul Mukhtar, 1: 387

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ اٰتِ مُحَمَّدَانِ الْوَسِيْلَةَ وَالْفَضِيْلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُوْدَانِ الَّذِيْ وَعَدْتَّهٗ. اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ.

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: Giving Iqamat in a pure state.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: Performing Iqamat facing the Qibla and keeping both feet facing the Qibla with a space of four fingers between the two feet.
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Hadith No-499/Ad Durrul Mukhtar, 1:389

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat:
A. Hadr in Iqamah i.e. stopping saying the first four takbeers together in one breath and saying saqeen at the end of each takbeer. (Tirmidhi, Hadith No. 195)

b. Then, between the middle sentences, say two sentences together in one breath, and rest at the end of each sentence. (Kanjul Ummal, Hadith No-23210)

c. Saying 'La-Ilaha Illallah' together with the last two takbirs together in one breath and saying the Sakin at the end of both takbirs.

items.title: Sunnah 4

(But care should be taken not to turn the sinah and start saying Haya Alal Falah after finishing turning the face.)

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat: Many people stand with their hands tied during Iqamat or before tying Tahrima. But it is makruh to do so. The rule is to keep hands off at this time.

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat: Many do not respond to Iqamat. But it is mustahab to respond to Iqamat like the call to prayer.

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat:
Do not speak or do anything during the sermon. (Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah, hadith no-1758/Nasa'i, hadith no-1384, Tirmidhi, hadith no-496/ Abu Dawud, hadith no-345)

B. Dr. Apart from the deeds described in any Sahih hadith, there is no mention of so many virtues in relation to any other Nafal deed. It is also Sunnah to do some more deeds on Friday. Namely: wearing good and clean clothes, applying perfume, reciting Surah Kahf, reciting Durood Sharif more and more, reading Salatut Tasbeeh, making dua in your mind without raising your hands between two sermons, reciting the following Durood Sharif 80 times while sitting at your place after Asr prayer for all men and women.

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدِنِ النَّبِيِّ الْاُمِّيِّ وَعَلٰى اٰلِه وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمً

B. Dr. The merit of the mentioned Durood Sharif is that the reward of 80 years of worship is written in the deeds of the doer and his sins of 80 years are forgiven. (Ibn Bashkwal, Al Qawsul Badi Fis Salati Was Salami Alal Habibish Shafi'i, p. 284)

And engaging in dhikr and du'a earnestly from shortly before sunset until sunset.
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Hadith No-347/ Abu Dawud, Hadith No-1291/ Mustadarak, Hadith No- 3392/ Mustadarak, Hadith No- 8681

Reciting this dua with the hair on the top of the wife's forehead at Basr night:

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا جَبَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ . وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا جَبَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ . وَاَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat:
First create intimacy with the wife, then whenever intercourse is desired, first recite the following dua:

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا

amal_text.text: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat: After the night of Basr, organizing the feeding of Olima to relatives, friends, well-wishers and the poor and needy according to Tawfiq.

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: At least two people traveling together, preferably not traveling alone.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat:
from home-

بِسْمِ اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ

fall out

amal_text.text: بِسْمِ اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat: Stepping on the vehicle door saying 'Bismillah'.

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat:
After sitting properly in the vehicle recite this dua three times Allahu Akbar says:

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَاِنَّا اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْاَلُكَ فِىْ سَفَرِنَا هٰذَاالْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوٰى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضٰى اَللّٰهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهٗ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِىْ السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِى الْاَهْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَـاْبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوْءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِى الْمَالِ وَالْاَهْلِ.
items.reference: Muslim, Hadith No. 1342 / Nasa'i, Hadith No. 5513 / Abu Dawud, Hadith No. 2598, 2599

amal_text.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَاِنَّا اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْاَلُكَ فِىْ سَفَرِنَا هٰذَاالْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوٰى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضٰى اَللّٰهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهٗ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِىْ السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِى الْاَهْلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَـاْبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوْءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِى الْمَالِ وَالْاَهْلِ.

items.title: Sunnah 5
items.fazilat: If it is necessary to stay somewhere during the tour, stay somewhere in such a way that it does not disturb the movement of people etc.

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat: Say Allahu Akbar when you or the vehicle starts going up.

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat: Say Subhanallah when you or the vehicle starts to descend or descend.

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat:
Reciting these two or three times as soon as the destination is visible from a distance:

اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْهَا

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْهَا

items.title: Sunnah 9
items.fazilat:
Recite this dua while entering the destination:

اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا جَنَاهَا وَحَبِّبْنَا اِلٰی اَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِىْ اَهْلِهَا اِلَيْنَا.

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا جَنَاهَا وَحَبِّبْنَا اِلٰی اَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِىْ اَهْلِهَا اِلَيْنَا.

items.title: Sunnah 10
items.fazilat: The Messenger of Allah, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He will return home soon after completing his journey. It is not good to prolong the journey unnecessarily.

items.title: Sunnah 11
items.fazilat: Do not enter the house suddenly when returning home after a long day of travel. Instead, first come to the mosque of your village or neighborhood and pray two rak'ats. Then after reaching the news of coming home, he waited for a while and entered his house after meeting the people. Similarly, after a long trip, do not enter the house late at night.
items.reference: Muslim, Hadith No. 2769 / Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No. 1800

items.title: Sunnah 12
items.fazilat: Do not keep dogs, rattlesnakes and rattlers on the trip. Because the devil pursues them, the blessing of the journey is gone. It should be noted that keeping a dog at home is prohibited in Shari'a.
items.reference: Muslim, Hadith No. 1574 / Muslim Sharif, Hadith No. 2113

items.title: Sunnah 13
items.fazilat:
Reciting this Dua on returning from a trip:

اٰئِـبُوْنَ تَائِبُوْنَ عَا بِدُوْنَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُوْنَ.

amal_text.text: اٰئِـبُوْنَ تَائِبُوْنَ عَا بِدُوْنَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُوْنَ.

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: Cut nails once a week.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: Cut the nails before going to Jumu'ar prayer on Friday.

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat: Both hands (held in prayer shape) starting from shahadah finger of right hand successively cutting the nail of thumb of left hand. Then lastly cut the nails of the thumb of the right hand.

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat: Starting from the right toenail and ending with the left toenail.

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) did not push or move people from the road while walking.

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat: If anyone asked anything from the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, he would never say no.

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat: The Prophet sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam would not withdraw his blessed countenance from anyone's face until he withdrew his countenance.
items.reference: Ibn Majah, Hadith No-3716 / Abu Dawud, Hadith No-4794

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat: The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to greet each other first, then shake hands.
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Hadith No. 5214 / Bukhari Sharif Hadith No. 6265-6266

items.title: Sunnah 5
items.fazilat:
The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to smile while saying goodbye to someone and recite this dua:

اَسْتَوْدِ عُ اللهَ دِيْنَكُمْ وَاَمَانَتَكُمْ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ اَعْمَالِكُمْ.

(Abu Dawud, Hadith No. 2601)

And he used to recite these two verses to whom he sent away:

اَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَا تَضِيْعُ وَدَائِعُهٗ

amal_text.text: اَسْتَوْدِ عُ اللهَ دِيْنَكُمْ وَاَمَانَتَكُمْ وَخَوَاتِيْمَ اَعْمَالِكُمْ.
اَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَا تَضِيْعُ وَدَائِعُهٗ

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat:
The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to recite this dua when he achieved something desirable:

اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ بِنِعْمَتِهٖ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ.

amal_text.text: اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ بِنِعْمَتِهٖ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ.

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat:
On the other hand, if faced with any situation except the desire of the mind, he used to recite this dua:

اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰی كُلِّ حَالٍ.

amal_text.text: اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلٰی كُلِّ حَالٍ.

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat:
The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to recite this dua when faced with any problem:

يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ.

amal_text.text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ  بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ.

items.title: Sunnah 9
items.fazilat: When the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) looked at someone, he turned his full face.

items.title: Sunnah 10
items.fazilat: Huzoor sallallaahu alayhi wa sallam always looked down upon creation.

items.title: Sunnah 11
items.fazilat: The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to lean slightly forward while walking.

items.title: Sunnah 12
items.fazilat: The beloved Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) lived in harmony with everyone.

items.title: Sunnah 13
items.fazilat: If any poor or old woman wanted to talk, he would go to one side of the road and listen to them.

items.title: Sunnah 14
items.fazilat: If he needed to leave the house at night, he would get up very slowly and quietly open the door and go out.

items.title: Sunnah 15
items.fazilat: When a child is seven years old, make him accustomed to perform the prayer.

items.title: Sunnah 16
items.fazilat: If the child is ten years old, beating with hands for prayer if necessary.

items.title: Sunnah 17
items.fazilat: To show due respect to dignitaries of all castes.

items.title: Sunnah 18
items.fazilat: Divide the day into three parts.

items.title: Sunnah 19
items.fazilat: Reciting more Durood, treating neighbors well.

items.title: Sunnah 20
items.fazilat: Maintaining good relations by forgiving the misbehavior of a relative.

items.title: Sunnah 21
items.fazilat: After the birth of the child, calling the Adhan in the right ear and Iqamat in the left ear, naming the beautiful and aqeeqah.

items.title: Sunnah 22
items.fazilat: Keeping close relations with relatives.

items.title: Sunnah 23
items.fazilat: Bogle, the lower part of the navel should be kept clean regularly.

items.title: Sunnah 24
items.fazilat: It is obligatory to keep the beard at least one fist, keep the mustache short.

items.title: Sunnah 25
items.fazilat: Watch out for the weak.

items.title: Sunnah 26
items.fazilat: Making jokes to please his wife.

items.title: Sunnah 27
items.fazilat: Meeting a Muslim brother with a smile.

items.title: Sunnah 28
items.fazilat: Sneezing or yawning is actually covering the mouth with hands or cloth.

items.title: Sunnah 29
items.fazilat: Don't dress like heathens.

items.title: Sunnah 30
items.fazilat: Strengthening one's faith, learning worship, halal sustenance, fulfilling the rights of the servant, avoiding sin and calling to religion.
items.reference: Surah Baqarah, verse 177 / Tirmidhi, hadith no-2267

categories.title: Sunnahs at the time of death

items.title: Sunnah 1
items.fazilat: Turning the face of the dying person towards the Qiblah and reciting Kalima Sharif while sitting in front of him. But do not order him to recite the Kalima and recite Surah Yaseen while sitting beside him.
items.reference: Mustadarak, Hadith No. 1305 / Muslim, Hadith No. 916 / Abu Dawud, Hadith No. 3121

items.title: Sunnah 2
items.fazilat:
If you feel that your death is near, keep reciting this dua:

اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْلِيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ وَاَ لْحِقْنِيْ بِالرَّفِيْقِ الْاَعْلٰى
items.reference: Tirmidhi, Hadith No-3496 / Abu Dawud, Hadith No-3121

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْلِيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ وَاَ لْحِقْنِيْ بِالرَّفِيْقِ الْاَعْلٰى

items.title: Sunnah 3
items.fazilat:
When the spirit is felt to be coming out, recite this dua:

اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعِنِّيْ عَلٰى غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَ سَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ .

amal_text.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعِنِّيْ عَلٰى غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَ سَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ .

items.title: Sunnah 4
items.fazilat: On hearing the news of the death of a Muslim read this dua: اَللّٰهُمَّ اْجُرْنِيْ فِـيْ مُصِيْبَتِيْ, وَاَخْلِفْ لِيْ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا.

amal_text.text: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ اْجُرْنِيْ فِـيْ مُصِيْبَتِيْ، وَاَخْلِفْ لِيْ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا.

items.title: Sunnah 5
items.fazilat: Closing the eyes and mouth of the dead person if they are open.

items.title: Sunnah 6
items.fazilat: Saying 'Bismillah' while placing the deceased on the bed.
items.reference: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaiba, Hadith No. 12062

items.title: Sunnah 7
items.fazilat: As soon as possible, after completing bath, shroud and funeral prayers, make arrangements for burial.

items.title: Sunnah 8
items.fazilat:
Reciting this dua while burying the dead body:

بِاسْمِ اللهِ وَعَلٰى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ.
items.reference: Abu Dawud, Hadith No. 1046 / Musnad Ahmad, Hadith No. 4989

amal_text.text: بِاسْمِ اللهِ وَعَلٰى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ.

items.title: Sunnah 9
items.fazilat: In the grave, the body should be completely laid on the right side, that is, the face and chest should be facing the Qibla.

items.title: Sunnah 10
items.fazilat: Arrangement of food for the family of the deceased on the first day by the relatives.
items.reference: Bukhari Sharif, Hadith No. 5417 / Musnad Ahmad, Hadith No. 905

items.title: Sunnah 11
items.fazilat: Graves should not be raised too high and paved.

items.title: Sunnah 12
items.fazilat: Sprinkling water on the grave.

items.title: Sunnah 13
items.fazilat: Dua for forgiveness after completing burial.

items.title: Sunnah 14
items.fazilat: Recitation of Surah Baqarah from the beginning to مُفْلِحُوْنْ towards the head of the grave and from Amanَ الرَّسُوْلُ to the end.

amal_text.text: مُفْلِحُوْنْ
آمَنَ الرَّسُوْلُ
